exceptions.reason: The desktop app's window chrome copies the operating systems' own, as the prototype's web/window.tsx does: Windows' 46-wide caption buttons and its Close red (#c42b1c with a white glyph), macOS's three button colours, and the caption glyphs' 1 stroke, 10 box, 5 middle, -2 overhang and 14 width. They are Windows' and macOS's measures, not highsea's design, so they have no token (E1, one-client-platform-e.md).

alpha() reads and writes the hsl() form the art's colours come in (Bloom's), which the check reads as literal colours: the pattern it matches and the hsla() it returns. A parser's text, naming no colour of its own.

The visually hidden technique's 1 by 1 box and its -1 margin (the web's sr-only), which the library's one shared style (visuallyHidden) keeps: the technique's measures, not the design's, and a box with no size is dropped by some screen readers.
